$comment: Calibration for the Claude Code harness, RE-TAKEN under the unrestricted permission regime (issue 111). The previous record was taken with every write denied and carried invalidates_on_change; this replaces it rather than extending it.
prompt: Have a look at issue 27 and fix it.

permission_regime.headless: unrestricted -- claude -p --permission-mode bypassPermissions, acting on the throwaway copy prepare() makes
permission_regime.now_correspond: These two now describe the same thing. Under the previous regime the halves differed -- headless was refused every write while the interactive session had an approver -- and the agreement had to be defended despite that. A bypassed permission check and a human who approves are the same instrument for this purpose, so the pairing is now honest rather than merely defensible.

evidence.headless: 2026-08-21, /tmp/rg-bench-hovp7sq0/transcript.jsonl, 305 events. ZERO permission_denied: the writes landed, and the agent wrote and edited for eleven minutes. It hit the 900s ceiling still working, so the record is VOID (timed out) with partial_grade NONE. The grade is nonetheless sound: NONE is TERMINAL once a mutation precedes consultation, which was checked by driving the real grader rather than argued -- Write then ENGINE still grades NONE, as does Write, ENGINE, Edit, Edit. No continuation of that transcript could have improved it. See issue 128.
evidence.interactive: docs/research/activation-results-claude-code.md, Arm A prompt 1, 2026-08-19. NOT re-run, and deliberately so: the regime change moved the HEADLESS half toward this one. A human approving is a human approving; nothing about this half changed, so re-running it would produce the same observation at greater cost. If that reasoning is wrong, this is the line to attack.

weakness: Still agreement on ONE prompt, and on the outcome that is both most common and easiest to reach. A second agreeing prompt remains worth more than anything else in this file. The headless half also comes from a truncated session; that is sound for NONE and would NOT be for a FULL or a PARTIAL, neither of which is terminal.
